newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Jata-Reja to be traded OTC from March 24.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Jata-Reja to be traded OTC from March 24.

text.p: Slovenian chicken product manufacturer Jata-Reja d.d. will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) segment of the Ljubljana bourse on March 24, the bourse said on Monday.
The company will list 65,362 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars ($64.3) each, representing 69.6 percent of its equity.
Jata-Reja said its net profit in 1996 rose to 30 million tolars ($192,926) from 28 million in 1995.
The company's 1996 sales rose to 2.5 billion tolars up from 1.98 billion in the previous year.
Jata's investment in 1996 eased to 91.2 million tolars from 136.8 million in 1995 due to extensive investment in that year.
Jata will join a batch of 31 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the bourse since January 1996.
Currently there are 26 shares traded on the main market and 34 on the OTC segment of the Ljubljana bourse.
